verdict.rationale: EFTPS documents its own scheduling capability: payments can be scheduled up to 365 days in advance and later changed or cancelled, with settlement on the selected date. That is advance scheduling of individual payments, though. Nothing documents recurring schedules, and there is no API or OpenAPI spec for programmatic scheduling, only the web UI, phone line, and Batch Provider software. Missing for 10: documented recurring or repeating payment schedules, programmatic or API-driven scheduling for agents, multi-step workflow automation, independent corroboration.
